notes: Brand Kit Pro v17.7.25: (1) SELECTABLE LOGOS — every stamped logo is now a separate named item on the document layer ("Logo — Cup", "Logo — Signage", …), not nested inside the sheet group: click it and only the logo selects, movable/resizable/recolorable, photo stays put. (2) ONE SPACING SYSTEM — base unit 12: sheets margin 36, gutter 24; book margin 48, gutter 24; same gaps everywhere. (3) MOCKUP VARIETY — the repeat bug is fixed: every Generate re-fetches fresh, each of the 18 zones gets a DIFFERENT realistic photo (no URL reused, realism scoring prefers real photos over renders/illustrations). (4) SEND TO MUSE — one-click Generate auto-exports the guideline PDF, and the new "Send to Muse" button prepares a package (PDF + plan + logo + manifest + upload spec + brief) so Muse can build the final guideline with the best online mockups. Logo-on-mockup rules unchanged: uniform scale, 15% clearspace, 64px/20mm min-size floor, variant rule, tint under logo. Mockups download at runtime only; live manifest keeps the full 22-file list (PNGs excluded: updater is text-only).
